enum.name: FUEL_CELL_CONTROL_COMMAND
enum.description: Persistent FCS start/stop command sent to the fuel cell controller.

entry.name: FUEL_CELL_CONTROL_COMMAND_OFF
entry.description: Turn the fuel cell controller off.

entry.name: FUEL_CELL_CONTROL_COMMAND_ON
entry.description: Turn the fuel cell controller on.

enum.name: FUEL_CELL_DEVICE_STATE
enum.description: FCS system state reported by the fuel cell controller over CAN.

enum.name: FUEL_CELL_CONNECTION_STATE
enum.description: State of the fuel cell controller connection.

entry.name: FUEL_CELL_CONNECTION_STATE_NEVER_CONNECTED
entry.description: No valid device status frame has been received.

entry.name: FUEL_CELL_CONNECTION_STATE_ERROR_OCCURRED
entry.description: The device was previously connected, but communication is currently lost.

enum.name: FUEL_CELL_VALID_FLAGS
enum.description: Validity of the thirteen fuel-cell values. Bit0 is reserved after requested_power removal; existing bit assignments are preserved. Clear means unavailable, unconfirmed or stale.

entry.name: FUEL_CELL_VALID_STACK_CURRENT
entry.description: stack_current in amperes is confirmed and valid. The source document's V unit must be resolved before setting this bit from TTL.

entry.name: FUEL_CELL_VALID_DCDC_TEMPERATURE_RAW
entry.description: dcdc_temperature_raw byte is available. This does not establish a physical temperature unit.

message.name: FUEL_CELL_CONTROL
message.description: Set the persistent FCS start/stop command or request a fault reset pulse on a separate CAN control bit. A fault reset switches the persistent command to OFF. Bus voltage, bus current and requested power are determined by the flight controller and cannot be modified by this message. New requests require a healthy CAN device connection, except an emergency stop preempting an active reset pulse.
message.field: Non-zero request identifier generated by the sender. Retries must use the same identifier and both control fields. Only the most recent request is cached, keyed by sender system/component and request identifier; duplicate requests return the original result without applying the command again.
System ID of the target vehicle. Zero broadcasts to all systems.
Component ID of the target autopilot. Zero broadcasts to all components.
Persistent fuel cell controller command.

Zero for a normal start/stop request; one requests a fault reset. A reset request forces the persistent command to OFF, except that EMERGENCY_STOP takes priority and cancels the reset. The flight controller transmits the separate CAN reset bit for three control-frame periods and then clears it. ACCEPTED means the pulse was started, not that the device cleared its fault.

message.name: FUEL_CELL_STATUS
message.description: Fuel cell controller connection, FCS state and command processing result. Published every 200 ms even when the CAN device is not connected, and immediately after connection changes or control request processing. Device state, SOC and DCDC output current are valid only while connection_state is OK. Receivers should mark this telemetry unavailable if no status is received for 1 second.
message.field: Request ID associated with control_result. Zero means no request has been processed.
Flight-controller-owned requested power currently used in CAN control frames. Read-only telemetry, not a device acknowledgement.
Last valid device lithium battery state of charge, in 0.01 percent. Valid only while connection_state is OK.

Last valid device DCDC output current, in 0.01 A. All raw values from 0 to 65535 are valid. Read-only telemetry independent of the PMU bus current. Retained after disconnection and valid only while connection_state is OK.
Last valid raw 4-bit FCS system state. States 0-13 are defined; unknown states 14-15 are forwarded without changing connection health or control permissions. Valid only while connection_state is OK.
FCS command currently saved and sent by the flight controller. Actual device operation is reported by device_state.

Processing result for response_request_id. ACCEPTED means that the flight controller saved the command or started the reset pulse, not that the device completed the operation. TEMPORARILY_REJECTED means that the CAN device is not connected or a start/stop request arrived during a reset pulse. DENIED means that a cached request identifier was reused with different control fields. UNSUPPORTED means that a control field is invalid.
Current fuel cell controller connection state.

message.name: FUEL_CELL_TELEMETRY
message.description: DRAFT private AI-box-to-QGC telemetry containing exactly the thirteen selected FCS fields after requested-power removal. No actuator or start/stop command. Units refer to normalized outgoing telemetry, not unconfirmed TTL byte layouts. Unknown floats must be NaN and their validity bits clear. Integer codes require validity bits. Nominal initial maximum rate 10 Hz, configurable and only on fresh source data. Private ID, not an official allocation.
message.field: Measurement timestamp in AI-box monotonic time since its OS boot, modulo 2^32. Not Unix time. Do not refresh this timestamp when repeating stale data.
Bitmask of valid business values. Unconfirmed source units, ambiguous source offsets and stale readings must have their bits clear.
Fuel-cell instance ID, initially 0. Source system/component IDs identify the aircraft and AI box separately.
Stack air-inlet temperature, described as ambient temperature in the FCS document.
Stack air-outlet temperature.
Fan duty cycle, 0 to 100 percent, not a fraction from 0 to 1.
Inlet valve raw state code. The source document does not define code meanings. Ignore if its valid bit is clear.
Stack gas-inlet pressure. Do not substitute gas-tank pressure from standard FUEL_STATUS.
Purge valve raw state code. No open/closed enum is assumed.
Fuel-cell stack voltage.
Fuel-cell stack current normalized to amperes. Source table says V, a contradiction; do not convert or mark valid until vendor confirmation.
DC/DC output voltage.
DC/DC output current.
DC/DC raw state code; source enum is pending.
DC/DC raw fault code; source enum is pending.
Unmodified Byte22 value, not a Celsius value. Unit, sign and scaling are unconfirmed. Add a new physical-temperature extension later instead of reinterpreting this byte.
